f7e9080df2.q: What type of law did Kate Boyd practice in New York before opening Kali Yoga?
f7e9080df2.a: Kate Boyd became a confidential clerk to the appellate division of the Supreme Court in New York State right out of law school, a two-year position where she worked with judges on both criminal and civil cases. After that, she worked as a confidential law clerk for Supreme Court Judge Leo Fallon for 10 years, and then prosecuted attorneys accused of professional misconduct for the Attorney Grievance Committee.

403eeac766.q: What is the main mantra that Kate Boyd and her partner Jen use when running Kali Yoga Buffalo?
403eeac766.a: Their daily mantra is 'we are learning.' When they make drastic mistakes, they remind themselves with this phrase. Kate explains that the first component is acknowledging what they don't know, and when they do make a mistake, they deal with it and learn from it—like discovering they needed to pay for music licensing rights or handling the Mat Fresher machine that arrived damaged.

5178a9c071.q: How did Kate Boyd transition from practicing law to opening a yoga studio?
5178a9c071.a: After stepping away from lawyering to focus on motherhood, Kate became deeply dedicated to her yoga practice, which she found transformative and opening to her worldview. She started taking teacher trainings and taught yoga for many years. When a colleague expressed interest in opening a studio together but later withdrew, Kate met with a teacher who had mentored her years earlier, and together they decided to open Kali Yoga Buffalo, 'jumping off the cliff' to launch the business.

842d7f9169.q: What licensing and regulatory requirements did Kali Yoga Buffalo have to navigate in New York State?
842d7f9169.a: In New York State, there is significant state intervention and taxation issues. Kate explains that they had to get certificates for everything at the state level and then certificates from the city as well, which involved a lot of regulatory and administrative work. Additionally, since they rent their space rather than own it, there were tangential issues to manage, including a complete renovation from a former mattress warehouse.
